Messages.Author: George Fink
Messages.Body:
Equipment is optional. But when do you have to declare use of
equipment?

For example, say I have a laptop. I declare a bleed against my prey.
Can I declare use of the laptop after my prey declines to block?
Can I un-declare use of the laptop after my prey deflects the bleed?

--George

Messages.Author: Wallpaper Paste
Messages.Body:
George Fink (gf...@avalon.cs.ucdavis.edu) wrote:

: Equipment is optional. But when do you have to declare use of
: equipment?



: --George

I should think that, since the laptop is optional, its use
could be declared analagous to conditioning et al. Once
declared, though, I'd say the use cannot be un-declared. That
probably wouldn't help in a deflection situation, but I can
think of a few rare circumstances in which it might be helpful.

Wallpaper Paste
for all those useless cards

Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
Use of equipment is always optional, but you can only take advantage of
the benefits thereof when you declare its use. Example: You cannot
gain the optional maneuver off of a .44 unless you use the "strike: 2R"
associated with it.
